plan_item: 77.44.7.A — Inspector Flex/Grid property visibility and Canvas context contract

finding.defect: registerProperty() allowed properties in the Grid group to declare a Flex-only container or parent context. isLayoutPropertyRelevant() would then present Grid controls in a Flex context even though the Grid property is not meaningful there.
finding.fix: Reject Grid-group registrations when their layout modes include flex. Flex-group shared properties retain explicit flex+grid support where appropriate (for example flex.gap and flex.alignSelf). Rejection is atomic.
finding.reuse_review: Reused the current Property Registry layoutContext contract and layout-presets relevance semantics. No external library implements this product-specific cross-check more narrowly; no third-party code or dependency was introduced.
